question.text: A trader buys a USDINR 83.50 call at Rs. 0.20. What is the BEP?

explanation.text: The Logic: Call BEP = Strike + Premium = 83.50 + 0.20 = 83.70. The Trap: At spot 83.50 the call is at-the-money (not ITM); it becomes ITM only when spot exceeds 83.50, and between 83.50 and 83.70 it is ITM but still net-loss after recovering the premium. The call turns profitable only above 83.70. Note: Page 81 of the NISM Series-I workbook gives the call BEP formula as strike plus premium, and page 69 supports the ITM/ATM moneyness terminology used here.
